prompt:
Draw a caricature of the person in the attached photo in a bold comic-book style: thick confident ink outlines, flat cel colours, one hard shadow tone, slightly exaggerated head-to-body ratio.

Likeness first: keep their hair, face shape, skin tone, eyebrows and smile recognisable, only exaggerating the features that are already distinctive.

Three running jokes, shown as props rather than text: (1) an oversized double espresso cup held like a trophy, (2) a phone with an absurdly long unread-messages badge, (3) three sticky notes stuck to the forearm, each with a scribbled to-do, unreadable.

Pose: three-quarter view, mid-gesture as if explaining something at length. Background: a flat warm-ochre colour with a single halftone-dot burst behind the head. No speech bubbles, no words, no logos.
